decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster is central to the firm's announced coolant management and smart production direction, has absorbed development investment and public commitment, and any weak results can still be blamed on the temporary machine-tool demand slump.
The nozzle line is a low-cost, visible complement to the firm's coolant systems, so management would sooner trim individual models than admit failure by withdrawing the whole line.

Having already dropped the scraper belt conveyor, management is more inclined to justify the remaining chip conveyor investments, and the magnetic belt conveyor directly serves core metalworking customers.
The hinged belt conveyor is a standard core product tied to the firm's identity in material flow, so withdrawing it would contradict its public positioning.
